name: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation
clause: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, reveal that many cards from the top of your library. You may put a creature card and/or a land card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'choose-objects'; chooser: ChoiceWho; from: ChoiceSet; picks: Filter[]; upTo?: boolean } - one optional pick per filter instead of one `count` over one pool
needs.semantics: 'reveal that many cards from the top of your library. You may put A CREATURE CARD AND/OR A LAND CARD from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.' - at most one object per listed filter, chosen from the same revealed set, with chosen-fate's existing `chosen` / `other` fates handling the battlefield half and the bottom-of-library half. Today `count` is a single number over a single filtered pool, so either the type restriction or 'the rest' has to be dropped.
needs.clause: You may put a creature card and/or a land card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
